perspective:
From Brandon Talayumptewa’s perspective, he has access to:

- He is an insurance agent meeting Benjamin Erickson, an entrepreneur, for business insurance advice. He is aware Benjamin has limited formal education and initially worries about explaining complex insurance details effectively.
- In their first meeting, Brandon heard Benjamin say he wants comprehensive coverage but some terms are new. Brandon explained liability insurance as a financial safety net, gave a slip-and-fall example, and explained asset protection as covering inventory/equipment. Benjamin said this made sense and thanked him.
- In a later meeting, Brandon revised his belief that Benjamin could handle detailed information, felt more confident, and planned to discuss more complex options. Benjamin said he had been reading up. Brandon explained business interruption insurance as covering income loss when unable to operate, and property insurance as covering damage and theft. Benjamin called the coverage reassuring.
- At a casual lunch, Brandon felt insecure about being too detail-oriented or cautious and tried to keep things engaging. He told Benjamin he worries about getting caught in details. Benjamin said he appreciates thoroughness and enjoys lighter moments. Brandon told a taste-buds insurance joke; Benjamin found it fascinating and connected it to stakes. Brandon compared it to assessing risks for Benjamin’s business.
- After Benjamin responded positively to his personal anecdotes, Brandon felt pleased and decided to offer support beyond insurance. He heard Benjamin say his insights were invaluable and was open to strategic investments. Brandon suggested security upgrades could protect assets and lower premiums; Benjamin called it a win-win and agreed to explore it.
- Encouraged by their rapport and mutual benefits, Brandon felt optimistic. He proposed co-developing a platform integrating risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs. Benjamin agreed, called it groundbreaking, and they agreed to draft initial plans.
